name: Promise of Loyalty
oracle_text: Each player puts a vow counter on a creature they control and sacrifices the rest. Each of those creatures can't attack you or planeswalkers you control for as long as it has a vow counter on it.
blocked_sentences: Each of those creatures can't attack you or planeswalkers you control for as long as it has a vow counter on it.

needs.what: a per-creature attack prohibition installed by a resolving spell: the chosen creatures (a binding) can't attack the spell's controller or planeswalkers that player controls, lasting for as long as each creature has a vow counter on it (checked when attackers are declared, ending when the counter is removed or the creature leaves)
needs.why_existing_wont_do: The cant_attack_player op names players on both sides (attacker/defender), not specific creatures, and its duration is only this_turn or this_combat, never 'while it has a <kind> counter'. The cant_attack_you static is scoped to the seat of the permanent carrying it, so granting it to each opponent's creature via grant_ability would make 'you' mean that creature's own controller, not the caster. The cant_attack static has no defender in its question at all.
